steps.name: verify two comment books after fresh reload
do: Runner.commentIndex=quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1252)+1; Runner.lastRequested=-1; assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); assert(quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')==Runner.lastRequested); assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex),quest:GetHero())); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do local expected=(i<2 or (name=='BookOwned' and (i==Runner.commentIndex or i==Runner.commentIndex-1))); assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==expected,name..'['..i..']') end end; for i=0,1 do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero())) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex-1),quest:GetHero())); Runner.twoCommentsLoaded=true
